title: Gamma product demo made with an AI video agent (Pexo) + screen-recorded how-to
summary: Two parts. 0-29 s is the finished output: a calm, generic product demo for Gamma with a neutral AI voiceover ('Every project starts the same way. Research, draft, format, repeat.'), centred two-line subtitles, a dark navy opener with a waveform-style line and blinking cursor, then pale blue-grey gradient backgrounds where screenshots of Gamma slides float as soft cards, ending on a 'Gamma / A better starting point, every time' logo card. 29-165 s is a raw low-res screen recording of the creator prompting an AI video agent (Pexo) in a chat UI, reviewing the render in its editor and downloading it.
fit_reason: Shows what a templated AI-generated SaaS demo looks like: washed-out, generic, watermark, unreadable UI shots; useful as a 'what not to settle for' baseline and as a format reference for a prompt-to-video tutorial.

palette.mood: dark navy opener then pale blue-grey misty gradients; soft and corporate, low contrast

typography.display: neutral UI sans (Inter look) medium, white on dark, slate on light
typography.size_behaviour: small: one centred headline line plus a duplicated subtitle near the bottom
typography.notes: Subtitle duplicates the headline text at first, then becomes the VO subtitle; 'Pexo' watermark bottom-right on every frame.

text_animation: word swap with fade (Every project… → Draft.)
captions: phrase — centred two-line white/slate sans subtitle near the bottom, no box, no highlight
motion: slow push-in on floating screenshot cards
cards float into a loose 2×2 arrangement
graphic_elements: thin horizontal line with a blue cursor block
screenshot cards with rounded corners and soft shadow
ui_treatment: flat screenshots of the product's output placed as floating cards, shot from far away so text is unreadable; second half is a raw full-screen browser capture

sound.voiceover: yes: neutral AI voice reading the script in part 1

signature_moves: VO + centred subtitle over floating product screenshots
dark opener → light misty gradient body → logo card
tutorial tail showing the prompt-to-video workflow

best_segments.what: Dark navy opener: 'Every project starts the same way.' over a thin line with a blue cursor, then 'Draft.' with blurred document cards behind, flowing into the first product shot.

recreate.how: Remotion/HTML: gradient background, screenshot cards with box-shadow and slow scale, TTS VO and SRT subtitles. To make it SaaSSuite-grade, zoom into readable UI crops and rebuild key UI instead of distant screenshots.
recreate.prompt: Calm SaaS demo with neutral voiceover: dark navy opener with one centred line of text over a thin line and blinking blue cursor, then pale blue-grey gradients with product screenshots floating as soft rounded cards, centred two-line subtitles, logo end card with tagline and button.
